key_insight: TopoFormer turns graph topology into short token sequences via Topo-Scan, letting a Transformer learn from multi-scale structural patterns without expensive persistent-homology diagrams.
engineering_relevance: It offers a parallelizable, lightweight way to inject topological inductive bias into scalable graph learning pipelines for classification and molecular prediction.
method: Slice graphs with node/edge filtrations to create ordered topological tokens.
Feed the resulting sequence into a Transformer for graph-level embeddings.
Use a stability-guaranteed topological encoding that avoids costly diagram computation.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports state-of-the-art results on graph classification and molecular property prediction, outperforming or matching strong GNN and topology-based baselines.
watch_item: Performance depends on how well Topo-Scan discretizes topology into short sequences, so filtration design and token length may affect expressiveness and compute.
paper_title: TopoFormer: Topology Meets Attention for Graph Learning
